verdict.rationale: The skills.sh installer writes skills into your repo as ordinary editable files you own, and nothing updates without your action. A hands-on probe selectively installed only the `tdd` skill to ./.claude/skills/tdd/ and read its SKILL.md back cleanly, so every installed file is reviewable afterward. Before installing, each SKILL.md is publicly readable on GitHub, and the installer lets you pick which skills to add. Missing for 10: no documented installer command to preview or list a skill's full file contents (including any scripts) before install, and no evidence on how inspectable the auto-updating read-only plugin bundle is.
